description: This file defines an abstract Client interface and two concrete implementations, TcpClient and VsockClient, for socket communication in the Android Open Source Project. It includes class declarations, constructors, and method signatures related to socket clients.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Abstract base class defining the interface for socket clients with methods to start the connection and describe it.

classes.name: TcpClient
classes.description: Concrete implementation of Client for TCP socket connections, with configurable host, port, and timeout.

classes.name: VsockClient
classes.description: Concrete implementation of Client for VSOCK connections, identified by id and port, with a flag for vhost user VSOCK.

methods.name: TcpClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing TCP client with host, port, and optional timeout.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Method to initiate the socket connection, returns a SharedFD.

methods.name: Describe
methods.description: Method to provide a textual description of the client.

methods.name: VsockClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing VSOCK client with id, port, and vhost user flag.
